entries.en: Added focus view toggle (`Ctrl+O`) in `NO_FLICKER` mode showing prompt, one-line tool summary with edit diffstats, and final response
entries.zh: 在`NO_FLICKER`模式下添加了焦点视图切换（`Ctrl+O`），显示提示、带有编辑差异统计的单行工具摘要以及最终响应

entries.en: Added `refreshInterval` status line setting to re-run the status line command every N seconds
entries.zh: 添加了 `refreshInterval` 状态行设置以每 N 秒重新运行一次状态行命令

entries.en: Added `workspace.git_worktree` to the status line JSON input, set when the current directory is inside a linked git worktree
entries.zh: 将`workspace.git_worktree`添加到状态行 JSON 输入，当当前目录位于链接的 git 工作树内时设置

entries.en: Added `● N running` indicator in `/agents` next to agent types with live subagent instances
entries.zh: 在具有实时子代理实例的代理类型旁边的`/agents`中添加了`● N running`指示符

entries.en: Added syntax highlighting for Cedar policy files (`.cedar`, `.cedarpolicy`)
entries.zh: 添加了 Cedar 策略文件的语法突出显示（`.cedar`、`.cedarpolicy`）

entries.en: Improved Accept Edits mode to auto-approve filesystem commands prefixed with safe env vars or process wrappers (e.g. `LANG=C rm foo`, `timeout 5 mkdir out`)
entries.zh: 改进“接受编辑”模式：对带有安全环境变量或进程包装器前缀的文件系统命令自动批准（如 `LANG=C rm foo`、`timeout 5 mkdir out`）

entries.en: Improved auto mode and bypass-permissions mode to auto-approve sandbox network access prompts
entries.zh: 改进自动模式和绕过权限模式：自动批准沙箱网络访问提示

entries.en: Improved sandbox: `sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` now takes effect on macOS
entries.zh: 改进：`sandbox.network.allowMachLookup` 现在在 macOS 上生效

entries.en: Improved image handling: pasted and attached images are now compressed to the same token budget as images read via the Read tool
entries.zh: 改进图片处理：粘贴和附加的图片现在压缩到与 Read 工具读取图片相同的 token 预算

entries.en: Improved slash command and `@`-mention completion to trigger after CJK sentence punctuation, so Japanese/Chinese input no longer requires a space before `/` or `@`
entries.zh: 改进斜杠命令和 `@` 提及的补全：中日文句号之后也会触发，因此日语和中文输入时，`/` 或 `@` 前不再需要空格

entries.en: Improved Bridge sessions to show the local git repo, branch, and working directory on the claude.ai session card
entries.zh: 改进 Bridge 会话：在 claude.ai 会话卡片上显示本地 git 仓库、分支和工作目录

entries.en: Improved footer layout: indicators (Focus, notifications) now stay on the mode-indicator row instead of wrapping below
entries.zh: 改进页脚布局：专注模式、通知等指示器保留在模式指示行上，不再换到下一行

entries.en: Improved context-low warning to show as a transient footer notification instead of a persistent row
entries.zh: 改进上下文不足警告：以临时的页脚通知显示，不再占用一行固定位置

entries.en: Improved markdown blockquotes to show a continuous left bar across wrapped lines
entries.zh: 改进 Markdown 引用块：跨行换行时显示连续的左侧竖线

entries.en: Improved session transcript size by skipping empty hook entries and capping stored pre-edit file copies
entries.zh: 改进会话转录大小：跳过空的 hook 条目，并限制保存的编辑前文件副本数量

entries.en: Improved transcript accuracy: per-block entries now carry the final token usage instead of the streaming placeholder
entries.zh: 改进转录准确性：每个块的记录现在带有最终的 token 用量，而不是流式输出时的占位值

entries.en: Improved Bash tool OTEL tracing: subprocesses now inherit a W3C `TRACEPARENT` env var when tracing is enabled
entries.zh: 改进 Bash 工具的 OTEL 追踪：开启追踪时，子进程会继承 W3C `TRACEPARENT` 环境变量

entries.en: Updated `/claude-api` skill to cover Managed Agents alongside the Claude API
entries.zh: `/claude-api` 技能现在涵盖 Managed Agents 以及 Claude API

entries.en: Fixed `--dangerously-skip-permissions` being silently downgraded to accept-edits mode after approving a write to a protected path
entries.zh: 修复了在批准写入受保护路径后`--dangerously-skip-permissions`被默默降级为接受编辑模式的问题

entries.en: Fixed and hardened Bash tool permissions, tightening checks around env-var prefixes and network redirects, and reducing false prompts on common commands
entries.zh: 修复并强化了 Bash 工具权限，加强了对 env-var 前缀和网络重定向的检查，并减少了常见命令的错误提示

entries.en: Fixed permission rules with names matching JavaScript prototype properties (e.g. `toString`) causing `settings.json` to be silently ignored
entries.zh: 修复了名称与 JavaScript 原型属性（例如`toString`）匹配的权限规则，导致`settings.json`被默默忽略

entries.en: Fixed managed-settings allow rules remaining active after an admin removed them until process restart
entries.zh: 固定的托管设置允许规则在管理员删除规则后保持活动状态，直到进程重新启动

entries.en: Fixed `permissions.additionalDirectories` changes in settings not applying mid-session
entries.zh: 修复了设置中的`permissions.additionalDirectories`更改未在会话中应用的问题

entries.en: Fixed removing a directory from `settings.permissions.additionalDirectories` revoking access to the same directory passed via `--add-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了从`settings.permissions.additionalDirectories`中删除目录以撤销通过`--add-dir`传递的同一目录的访问权限

entries.en: Fixed MCP HTTP/SSE connections accumulating ~50 MB/hr of unreleased buffers when servers reconnect
entries.zh: 修复了服务器重新连接时 MCP HTTP/SSE 连接每小时累积约 50 MB 未释放缓冲区的问题

entries.en: Fixed MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` not being honored on token refresh after restart, fixing ADFS and similar IdPs
entries.zh: 修复了重启后令牌刷新时不支持 MCP OAuth `oauth.authServerMetadataUrl` 的问题，修复了 ADFS 和类似的 IdP

entries.en: Fixed 429 retries burning all attempts in ~13 seconds when the server returns a small `Retry-After` — exponential backoff now applies as a minimum
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回一个小的`Retry-After`时，429 次重试会在约 13 秒内烧毁所有尝试 - 现在应用指数退避作为最小值

entries.en: Fixed rate-limit upgrade options disappearing after context compaction
entries.zh: 修复了上下文压缩后速率限制升级选项消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed several `/resume` picker issues: `--resume <name>` opening uneditable, Ctrl+A reload wiping search, empty list swallowing navigation, task-status text replacing conversation summary, and cross-project staleness
entries.zh: 修复了几个`/resume`选择器问题：`--resume <name>`打开不可编辑、Ctrl+A 重新加载擦除搜索、空列表吞噬导航、任务状态文本替换对话摘要以及跨项目陈旧性

entries.en: Fixed file-edit diffs disappearing on `--resume` when the edited file was larger than 10KB
entries.zh: 修复了当编辑的文件大于 10KB 时文件编辑差异在`--resume`上消失的问题

entries.en: Fixed `--resume` cache misses and lost mid-turn input from attachment messages not being saved to the transcript
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`缓存未命中和丢失的附件消息中的输入未保存到记录中的问题

entries.en: Fixed messages typed while Claude is working not being persisted to the transcript
entries.zh: 修正了克劳德工作时输入的消息不会保留到文字记录中的问题

entries.en: Fixed prompt-type `Stop`/`SubagentStop` hooks failing on long sessions, and hook evaluator API errors displaying "JSON validation failed" instead of the actual message
entries.zh: 修复了提示类型 `Stop`/`SubagentStop` 挂钩在长时间会话中失败，以及挂钩评估器 API 错误显示“JSON 验证失败”而不是实际消息的问题

entries.en: Fixed subagents with worktree isolation or `cwd:` override leaking their working directory back to the parent session's Bash tool
entries.zh: 修复了具有工作树隔离或`cwd:`覆盖的子代理将其工作目录泄漏回父会话的 Bash 工具的问题

entries.en: Fixed compaction writing duplicate multi-MB subagent transcript files on prompt-too-long retries
entries.zh: 修复了在提示时间过长的重试时压缩写入重复的多 MB 子代理转录文件的问题

entries.en: Fixed `claude plugin update` reporting "already at the latest version" for git-based marketplace plugins when the remote had newer commits
entries.zh: 修复了当远程有更新的提交时，基于 git 的市场插件的“claude 插件更新”报告“已经是最新版本”的问题

entries.en: Fixed slash command picker breaking when a plugin's frontmatter `name` is a YAML boolean keyword
entries.zh: 修复了当插件的 frontmatter `name` 是 YAML 布尔关键字时斜杠命令选择器中断的问题

entries.en: Fixed copying wrapped URLs in `NO_FLICKER` mode inserting spaces at line breaks
entries.zh: 修复了在`NO_FLICKER`模式下复制包装 URL 时在换行符处插入空格的问题

entries.en: Fixed scroll rendering artifacts in `NO_FLICKER` mode when running inside zellij
entries.zh: 修复了在 zellij 内运行时`NO_FLICKER`模式下的滚动渲染伪影

entries.en: Fixed a crash in `NO_FLICKER` mode when hovering over MCP tool results
entries.zh: 修复了将鼠标悬停在 MCP 工具结果上时`NO_FLICKER`模式下的崩溃问题

entries.en: Fixed a `NO_FLICKER` mode memory leak where API retries left stale streaming state
entries.zh: 修复了`NO_FLICKER`模式内存泄漏，其中 API 重试留下陈旧的流状态

entries.en: Fixed slow mouse-wheel scrolling in `NO_FLICKER` mode on Windows Terminal
entries.zh: 修复了 Windows 终端上`NO_FLICKER`模式下鼠标滚轮滚动缓慢的问题

entries.en: Fixed custom status line not displaying in `NO_FLICKER` mode on terminals shorter than 24 rows
entries.zh: 修复了在少于 24 行的终端上以`NO_FLICKER`模式不显示的自定义状态行

entries.en: Fixed Shift+Enter and Alt/Cmd+arrow shortcuts not working in Warp with `NO_FLICKER` mode
entries.zh: 修复了 Shift+Enter 和 Alt/Cmd+arrow 快捷键在`NO_FLICKER`模式下的 Warp 中不起作用的问题

entries.en: Fixed Korean/Japanese/Unicode text becoming garbled when copied in no-flicker mode on Windows
entries.zh: 修复了在 Windows 上以无闪烁模式复制时韩文/日文/Unicode 文本变得乱码的问题

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock SigV4 authentication failing when `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` or `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL` are set to empty strings (as GitHub Actions does for unset inputs)
entries.zh: 修复了当`AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK`或`ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL`设置为空字符串时 Bedrock SigV4 身份验证失败的问题（正如 GitHub Actions 对于未设置的输入所做的那样）
